correctness.rationale: For n>=7 count cyclic nonadjacent triples by three positive gaps: T=n(n-4)(n-5)/6; exact occupied pair counts are 0 at distance 1, n-5 at distance 2 and n-6 otherwise. Centering the circulant second moments and taking its Fourier transform gives gamma(n,k)=4[3/n-((n-6)(1+2cos theta)-2cos 2theta)/T] for k!=0, with the zero constant mode forced by the fixed particle number. The quadratic F_n(c)=3/n+[4c^2-2(n-6)c-(n-4)]/T decreases on the sampled domain for n>=10, and the short n=7,8,9 cases follow from exact root isolations/vertex distances. Its sampled positive spectrum is minimal at k=1,n-1 and maximal at the alternating modes. n=6 has two complementary configurations, covariance rank one and Walsh Gram eigenvalue 6. Expanding the exact extrema gives the squared condition ratio 1+8/n+O(n^-2). Independently generated all admissible triples and recomputed exact covariance, Fourier eigenvalues and extremal frequency comparisons at n=7..15 with separate code; these finite tests supplement the all-n quadratic proof.
